game: Weird Al's Museum of Natural Hilarity

sections.Profile:
"Weird Al" Yankovic plays curator of a fictitious museum whose five exhibit halls each hold two song modes, picked at a ticket counter on the way to the Running With Scissors wizard mode. Multimorphic's first licensed game for its P3 platform features 17 of the parody musician's songs and more than 2,000 voice callouts recorded by Al, with Stephen Silver as creative director and artwork by Matt Andrews.
